item.title: Ramp launches its own AI model router, called Router
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: Ramp has launched its own AI model routing service, dubbed Router, that lets users and companies use and switch between various large language models via an API.

item.title: Senators demand answers from TikTok over experiment that disabled safeguards
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The safeguard was designed to prevent users from being overwhelmed by harmful content, but TikTok wanted to determine whether it made the app less engaging.

item.title: Meta brings Pocket, an app that lets you vibe-code and share games, to US users
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta is bringing Pocket, its experimental AI-powered app for creating and sharing interactive games, to users across the U.S. after quietly testing it in Brazil.

item.title: The 2026 Startup Battlefield 200 is here — see who made the cut
item.dc:creator: Isabelle Johannessen, Michael Schick
item.description: We’re thrilled to unveil the 2026 Startup Battlefield 200, our annual handpicked list of the 200 most promising early-stage startups from around the world.

item.title: Patreon launches 30 new creator features, including short-form Clips and revamped discovery
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Patreon is overhauling how creators get discovered, adding short-form Clips, topic-based communities, and a revamped recommendation system designed to give smaller creators more visibility.

item.title: Inertia Enterprises finds a way to make its fusion fuel fast
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Fusion power startup Inertia Enterprises reduced the fuel filling process from a week to just a few hours. It's one of 10 hurdles the company must overcome to make a profitable power plant.

item.title: There are less than 48 hours to save up to $300 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: If you’ve been circling around Disrupt, then now’s the best time to lock in your pass and start getting ready to join the rest of the startup community gathering in San Francisco from October 13-15 at Moscone West!

item.title: Apollo Atomics wants to make nuclear power cheaper by shrinking an overlooked part
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Y Combinator alumnus Apollo Atomics is shrinking a key nuclear reactor part, which promises to slash the cost of electricity below natural gas.

item.title: AI data giant Alation confirms cyberattack
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The data search and AI giant confirmed unauthorized access to its systems during an incident on Tuesday, and said it was investigating the breach.

item.title: For a16z, AI gives foreign founders an advantage
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: a16z’s Borderless Founder network initiative supports immigrant and international founders. "Having one foot in your home country, and one foot in Silicon Valley" is an advantage, the firm believes.

item.title: US says hackers are targeting vulnerable water systems with the help of AI
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: Hackers are targeting internet-connected Siemens controllers used in water facilities around the United States.

item.title: Meta AI’s new Mac app wants you to talk to your apps
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: The company said that the dictation feature works across all apps, just like other tools such as Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, and Monologue.

item.title: Binance now lets AI agents trade, but keeping them in check is largely up to users
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Binance's Agent OS works with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Cursor.

item.title: Stripe didn’t really buy OpenRouter because of the ‘singularity’
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: What does a payments giant want with a startup that routes prompts between different AI models? Stripe says it's because of "the singularity" but it's really for a far more real and powerful reason.

item.title: Waymo’s cheaper, next-gen robotaxi is now open to all riders in these three cities
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: The next-generation robotaxi, called the Waymo Ojai, is central to the company's push towards mass scale, and eventually, profitability.

item.title: OpenAI seeks to one-up Anthropic with new customer privacy protections
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: A competition is developing between OpenAI and Anthropic over who can provide the best privacy protections for enterprise customer data.

item.title: Cognition CEO denies report that SpaceX tried to acquire the startup
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: SpaceX was reportedly in talks to buy AI coding startup Cognition. SpaceX has already acquired Cursor as it races to catch up to rivals like OpenAI and Anthropic in enterprise AI.

item.title: Travis Kalanick kicks off another round of VC bashing: ‘1% are helpful’
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: After raising $1.7 billion for his new robotics company Atoms, Travis Kalanick is introspective about the role VCs have played in his career.

item.title: Rillet raises $100M Series C at $1B valuation — 2 years after emerging from stealth
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: AI-native account startup Rillet became a unicorn, led by Iconiq, after it doubled its ARR in the past three months, it said.

item.title: Gwyneth Paltrow allegedly set to throw dinner in honor of Sam Altman
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: The actress' firm Kinship Ventures is an investor in the company.
